scripts.mobile:build:ios:development: cd apps/mobile && bunx eas build -p ios --profile development
scripts.mobile:build:ios:preview: cd apps/mobile && bunx eas build -p ios --profile preview
scripts.mobile:build:ios:production: cd apps/mobile && bunx eas build -p ios --profile production
scripts.mobile:build:android:development: cd apps/mobile && bunx eas build -p android --profile development
scripts.mobile:build:android:preview: cd apps/mobile && bunx eas build -p android --profile preview
scripts.mobile:build:android:production: cd apps/mobile && bunx eas build -p android --profile production
scripts.mobile:build:production: bun run mobile:build:ios:production && bun run mobile:build:android:production
scripts.mobile:submit:ios:production: cd apps/mobile && bunx eas submit -p ios --profile production --latest
scripts.mobile:submit:android:production: cd apps/mobile && bunx eas submit -p android --profile production --latest
scripts.mobile:submit:production: bun run mobile:submit:ios:production && bun run mobile:submit:android:production
